Export AI Segmentation Results in IHE AIR Standardized DICOM Format

Source: R/segment-ai.R
ai_export_results.Rd

Writes segmentation masks as a DICOM SEG object (write_dicom_seg()) and quantitative summary metrics as a DICOM TID 1500 Measurement Report (dicom_sr_tid1500()), aligned with IHE AI Results (AIR) conventions.

Usage

ai_export_results(
  seg_res,
  vol,
  out_dir,
  title = "IHE AIR AI Segmentation Report"
)

Arguments

seg_res

A "dicom_ai_segmentation" object from ai_segment(), or a dicom_seg object.

vol

Reference dicom_volume object.

out_dir

Output directory for standardized DICOM files.

title

Report title for the TID 1500 Measurement Report.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with seg_path, sr_path, out_dir, and metrics.
